svg.title: Gross checkout receipts to net contribution margin
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-slo-contribution-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Gross checkout receipts to net contribution margin; subtitle: Illustrative $100 blended basket on Merchant-of-Record rails; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD per $100 gross checkout basket; opening and closing bars are totals, middle bars are deductions.; caption: $100 gross receipts less $5.50 MoR processing, $4.00 refund reserve, $12.00 affiliate/support allocation, and $23.50 media spend leaves $55.00 contribution.; stages: label: Gross basket; value: $100.00; numeric value: 100.0; detail: Combined front-end SKU, order bump, and post-purchase upsell receipts excluding pass-through VAT.; label: MoR & payment fee; value: -$5.50; numeric value: -5.5; detail: Merchant-of-Record 5% + $0.50 fee handling global VAT/sales-tax remittance and fraud screening.; label: Refunds & disputes; value: -$4.00; numeric value: -4.0; detail: 4% combined refund and dispute allowance under clear click-to-cancel terms.; label: Support & affiliates; value: -$12.00; numeric value: -12.0; detail: Blended affiliate payout share and Tier-1 support/fulfillment automation cost.; label: Net ad spend; value: -$23.50; numeric value: -23.5; detail: Paid media outlay net of Day-1 SparkLoop / co-registration lead-magnet liquidation.; label: Contribution margin; value: $55.00; numeric value: 55.0; detail: Closing contribution before fixed studio opex, contractor retainers, and owner taxes.
